Package com.mendix.core.actionmanagement.internal

Class InternalCoreAction<R>

java.lang.Object
com.mendix.core.actionmanagement.internal.InternalCoreAction<R>
Type Parameters:
R - the result type of the action
All Implemented Interfaces:
ICoreAction<R>, Callable<R>
Direct Known Subclasses:
UserAction
public abstract class InternalCoreAction<R> extends Object implements ICoreAction<R>
Provides the (internal) interface to an action that can be executed. This is an internal class that is not to be used and may change any time.
